pagetitle: "Zindel Lab — ETH Zürich"
description: "The Zindel Lab at ETH Zürich studies tissue repair, fibrosis, and foreign-body responses through intravital imaging of immune and cellular dynamics."
toc: false

::: {.lab-hero}
::: {.lab-hero-text}
![Zindel Lab](assets/logo.webp){.lab-hero-logo}

[ETH Zürich · Institute of Molecular Health Sciences · D-BIOL]{.hero-place}

We study how the body repairs itself after injury and surgery — and why repair so often leaves a scar. By uncovering the cellular and molecular mechanisms of healing, we aim to improve recovery, prevent complications, and help implants integrate rather than fail.

Beyond the bench, we translate discoveries into innovations — collaborating with industry, supporting entrepreneurship, and training the next generation of scientists and clinicians in regenerative medicine and surgical care.
:::

  var tiles = Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.children);
  for (var i = tiles.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
